title: Coherent ring inverse image with constant coefficients
statement: Let $(C,J)$ and $(D,K)$ be small sites in a universe $u$. Suppose $L:\operatorname{Sh}(J,\mathrm{Type}_u)\rightleftarrows\operatorname{Sh}(K,\mathrm{Type}_u):V$ is an adjunction and $L$ preserves finite limits. There are a functor $F:\operatorname{Sh}(J,\mathrm{CRing}_u)\to\operatorname{Sh}(K,\mathrm{CRing}_u)$ and, for each ring sheaf $R$, a ring inverse-image presentation $d_R$ of $L,R,F(R)$ [def-weil-pbc-ring-inverse-image], such that $L(|f|);e_S=e_R;|F(f)|$ for every ring-sheaf map $f:R\to S$, where $e_R$ is the underlying comparison of $d_R$. Moreover there is a natural isomorphism $\underline{(-)}_J;F\cong\underline{(-)}_K$ of functors from commutative rings to ring sheaves, for the actual sheafified constant-ring functors [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. No module-sheaf inverse image, module action, module morphism or derived functor is asserted.

source.place: Tag 00YV, proposition-functoriality-algebraic-structures-topoi, rings as sextuples; constant objects as coproducts of the terminal sheaf. Ring-only subargument of inverseImageData_exists.

proof.text: Apply inverseImage_ring_functor to the given adjunction. It supplies a ring-sheaf functor F and a natural underlying isomorphism e, with explicit equations transporting addition, multiplication, zero and one by the product and terminal comparisons.

For each test sheaf T, write the binary-operation graph t=a op b as t=lift(a,b);op by sectionwise extensionality. Apply L and the operation-comparison equation. The product projections show that L(lift(a,b));comparison;(e tensor e) equals lift(L(a);e,L(b);e). Evaluating on target sections proves ringAdd and ringMul. Similarly write a constant graph as a=toUnit(T);q. The terminal-comparison equation and uniqueness of maps into the terminal object prove ringZero and ringOne. These are the fully proved private transport_binary and transport_constant lemmas. The naturality equation is e.hom.naturality.

Apply inverseImageConstantComparison to F, its just-proved generalized-section ring presentations, and the naturality equation. Retain its natural constant-ring isomorphism. Copy the four graph fields and underlying comparison from CategoryTheory.RingInverseImage to SheafOfModules.RingInverseImage and assemble the existential witnesses.

proof_origin.place: Tag 00YV, rings as sextuples, using the existing ring-lift and constant-comparison statements. Generalized-section graph laws are derived by universal pairings and the unique terminal arrow; Lean implementation by C3, 2026-10-28.

theorem coherentRingInverseImage_exists
    {C D : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {K : GrothendieckTopology D}
    (L : Sheaf J (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf K (Type u))
    (V : Sheaf K (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type u)) (adj : L ⊣ V)
    [PreservesFiniteLimits L] :
    ∃ (F : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u} ⥤ Sheaf K CommRingCat.{u})
      (d : ∀ R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}, SheafOfModules.RingInverseImage L R (F.obj R)),
      (∀ {R S : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}} (f : R ⟶ S),
        L.map ((sheafCompose J (forget CommRingCat)).map f) ≫ (d S).ringUnderlying.hom =
          (d R).ringUnderlying.hom ≫ (sheafCompose K (forget CommRingCat)).map (F.map f)) ∧
      Nonempty (constantSheaf J CommRingCat.{u} ⋙ F ≅ constantSheaf K CommRingCat.{u})
